g1.label: 1. every state has a big State ___
g1.why: A State Fair is the summer event with rides, animals and food.

g2.label: 2. popcorn and ice ___
g2.why: Ice cream is the fixed compound for the frozen dessert.

g3.label: 3. families ___ Thanksgiving
g3.why: You celebrate a holiday; 'cancel' and 'collect' do not fit a festival.

g4.label: 4. They cook a big ___
g4.why: Turkey is the traditional Thanksgiving meal.

g5.label: 5. a long ___ through the town
g5.why: A parade is a procession through the streets.

g6.label: 6. you can watch ___ over the lake
g6.why: Fireworks are the lights set off in the sky on the Fourth of July.

g7.label: 7. houses have colourful ___
g7.why: Decorations are what you put up to make a place look festive.

g8.label: 8. a good chance to meet your ___
g8.why: Neighbours are the people living close by, who meet at festivals.

g1.label: 1. a special day when people do not work
g1.why: A holiday is a day off work, often to celebrate something.

g2.label: 2. people walking with music and costumes
g2.why: That public procession through the streets is a parade.

g3.label: 3. lights and colours you put up
g3.why: Things put up to make a place festive are decorations.

g4.label: 4. something you give on a special day
g4.why: A present is a gift given to someone.

g5.label: 5. bright lights and loud bangs
g5.why: Fireworks explode in the night sky with light and noise.

g6.label: 6. when farmers bring in the food
g6.why: The harvest is the time crops are gathered from the fields.

g7.label: 7. a big event with music, food and games
g7.why: A festival is a public celebration held in a town.

g8.label: 8. people in the houses next to yours
g8.why: Neighbours live in the houses beside your own.

g1.label: 1. Every November we ___ Thanksgiving
g1.why: You celebrate a festival; the object here is Thanksgiving.

g2.label: 2. We ___ the house with lights
g2.why: To decorate means to put up lights and ornaments.

g3.label: 3. My parents ___ our neighbours to dinner
g3.why: You invite people to come to a meal or party.

g4.label: 4. At the State Fair you can ___ food
g4.why: To try food means to taste it for the first time.

g5.label: 5. Thousands of people ___ the parade
g5.why: You watch something that moves past, like a parade.

g6.label: 6. Children ___ their presents
g6.why: Presents are wrapped, so you open them.

g7.label: 7. The festival ___ place in the town centre
g7.why: 'Take place' is the fixed phrase meaning to happen.

g8.label: 8. After the fireworks everybody ___ home
g8.why: 'Everybody' is singular, so the present simple takes -es: goes.
